title: Week 6 Practice: Circles, Similarity, and Coordinate Geometry
description: Use this set to mix circle formulas, similarity ratios, and coordinate geometry basics.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with radius 5?
Two similar triangles have side ratio $2:5$. What is the corresponding area ratio?
questions.explanation: Area scales by the square of the side ratio.

questions.question: Find the midpoint of $(2,4)$ and $(8,10)$.
questions.explanation: Average the x-values and y-values separately.

questions.question: Find the slope of the line through $(1,3)$ and $(5,11)$.
A vertical line has undefined slope.
questions.explanation: Its run is zero, so the slope denominator is zero.

questions.question: If two figures are similar with side ratio $3:4$, then their areas are also in ratio $3:4$.
questions.explanation: Area scales by the square of the side ratio: $9:16$.

questions.question: Find the distance between $(0,0)$ and $(3,4)$.
questions.explanation: Use the distance formula or recognize the 3-4-5 triangle.

questions.question: A line with slope 3 is perpendicular to another line. What is the perpendicular slope?
